before.scope: Five-second aggregate and CPU0 idle samples plus live build/codec/profiler process checks. Load averages are diagnostic only: dedicated VM use is exclusive and historical own work requires no cooldown. Recheck immediately before and after every statistical run; does not prove future hypervisor isolation.

receipt.name: WarmNearestResize
receipt.boundary: One resident original 513x259 RGBA8 raster to independently owned 1027x519 nearest output at the same sample depth. Complete public Resize, admission, allocation/materialization/disposal. Native public FFmpeg filter graph includes packing/plane extraction, separate RGB and replicated-alpha zscale point kernels, merging, output pixel allocation/release. Graph/source/frame wrappers and geometry contexts are reused; every call filters every selected sample. Native padded output rows exposed directly. Exact integer center mapping, alpha and hidden RGB. No codec, expression evaluator or output cache. Startup, IPC, I/O, generation, hashing and validation excluded; one CPU/filter thread, normal SIMD. Only this fixed resize case is measured.
